items.author: Mauricio Ayala-Rincón; David M. Cerna; Temur Kutsia; Christophe Ringeissen

items.difficulty_reason: The construction combines two rule-based generalization procedures while preserving solved-instantiation invariants across signature abstraction and concretization. Termination uses a multiset measure on theory heights and finite alternation of component algorithms; soundness and completeness use the explicit alien-subterm correspondence construction and its proof. The final white-box combination and full supporting black-box proof are retained as one H2 item, rather than counted as separate variants.
